summary: Full-stack testing of LMS Pemberdayaan. Backend pytest suite: 19/19 tests pass (100%) covering auth, RBAC, programs CRUD, courses/modules, enrollments idempotency, progress mark/unmark, submissions & grading, achievement KPI, instructor overview, admin stats. Frontend: all 4 role logins work, admin/donor/instructor/student dashboards render with correct KPIs, seeded 'Literasi Digital Desa' program and 'Dasar Komputer' course visible, student can enroll, mark modules done (progress % updates 0->33%), submit assignment on module #2 (has_assignment=true) via drive link, instructor grading page shows submission with 85 score entered. All data-testid selectors work. RBAC verified via 403 responses.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by dev instrumentation attribute wrappers (x-dynamic spans) inside <option> in Programs.jsx line 83 donor select. Non-blocking but produces console errors.

action_items: (Optional) Fix hydration warning in Programs.jsx donor <select><option>: avoid wrapper spans inside <option>. Likely from dev tooling; safe to ignore in production build.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~776 lines - acceptable but approaching 700 line split threshold; consider splitting into routers/programs.py, routers/courses.py etc.
In list_programs / list_courses / instructor_overview, N+1 style queries per doc (courses inside loop of programs). Fine for small datasets, may need aggregation pipelines at scale.
seed_admin correctly upserts password if changed (good). No donor/instructor/student self-seed - relies on manually created demo accounts existing in DB, which they do.
CORS uses allow_origins from env split by ',' with default '*' - fine, but combined with allow_credentials=True and '*' would fail in strict browsers. Prod should set explicit origins.
Progress.delete_many is unbounded; not risky since scoped by student_id+module_id.
test_credentials: admin@lms.id/Admin123!, donor@lms.id/donor123, instr@lms.id/instr123, student@lms.id/stud123 (all verified working)
seed_data_creation: Only created/deleted TEST_-prefixed data during tests. Cleaned up in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs 19 tests in ~10s. All roles seeded and working. Test the hydration warning in Programs.jsx <select> if it becomes user-visible. UI selectors use data-testid consistently: login-form, login-email/password/submit, program-form, mark-done-btn, submit-drive-link, submit-assignment-btn, curriculum-item-{id}, my-course-{id}.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Minor: React console hydration warning caused by dev-time instrumentation attribute injectors that wrap dynamic option text in a <span>, which is invalid HTML inside <option>. Not a bug in the app code itself; will not appear in production build without emergent instrumentation.
